messages:
security-bot: ALERT: public-container-listing detected — storage account 'redwood-backups' has container 'daily-exports' with public listing enabled via CORS. Severity: medium. Rule: storage-listing-public-2026
amanda: seeing the alert now. which region?
raj: US-EAST1 (storage-prd-us). I pulled the diagnostic: CORS allowedOrigins included '*' and container ACL is 'blob' (list allowed).
liam: can you paste the exact diagnostic command you ran?
raj: ran `az storage container show --account-name redwoodbackups --name daily-exports --auth-mode login` and `az storage cors list --account-name redwoodbackups`
sofia: quick ask: any customer data in that container?
amanda: preliminary: mostly automated export snapshots and telemetry, might include ephemeral paths with file names. Not aware of PII but need to assume potential exposure until we confirm.
jessica: I'm going to apply containment: set container to private and lock CORS. Doing `az storage container set-permission --account-name redwoodbackups --name daily-exports --public-access off` now.
security-bot: ACTION: containment initiated by jessica at 1782103530
raj: confirmed ACL change. `az storage container show` now returns publicAccess: null. CORS list also updated to remove '*' by `az storage cors add --account-name redwoodbackups --origins https://console.redwood.ai --services b`
liam: good. Next: rotate any shared SAS tokens that were issued for this container in the last 30 days. Querying keyvault logs for SAS issue events.
amanda: also check IAM role assignments to see if any wide roles were added to service principals last week. `az role assignment list --scope /subscriptions/xxx/resourceGroups/infra/providers/Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/redwoodbackups`
raj: found two role assignments for AppID `rdw-data-mover` with role 'Storage Blob Data Contributor' created 3 days ago by pipeline `infra-deploy`.
sofia: flagging that pipeline. @jessica can you disable the pipeline run until we validate?
jessica: pausing pipeline `infra-deploy` now.
liam: I'm pulling KeyVault access logs and KMS usage. If any keys were used to sign SAS tokens we need to rotate. KeyVault shows `createSas` calls from `rdw-data-mover` 6 times in the past 48h.
amanda: coordinate with platform to rotate both storage account keys and relevant KeyVault key material. Notify customers if required after deeper review.
raj: I've created an internal ticket INF-4672 to revoke existing SAS tokens and issue new scoped tokens if needed. Assigning to @liam and @sofia.
sofia: on it — running audit of objects list. If nothing sensitive, we'll do a mitigated disclosure to legal.
tony-legal: looped in. If we confirm no customer PII, we can send a short notification to affected customers with remediation and no public disclosure. If PII present, follow breach protocol.
amanda: quick timeline: detection 1782103456, containment (ACL off) 1782103530, pipeline paused 1782103602, rotating keys 1782103720, initial audit results ETA 60m.
security-bot: NOTE: audit-log export saved to s3://redwood-security-exports/1782103456-audit.zip
liam: audit gist: ~1200 objects listed publicly, mostly JSON metrics and rotated snapshots. Found 3 files with full email values in metadata keys. Marking as sensitive.
sofia: ok we have confirmed sensitive data. Tony — proceed with breach notification steps. I'll start building the affected list.
tony-legal: started official incident record INC-2026-042. Need point of contact for customers, draft statement, and timeline. Amanda, please assign communicator.
amanda: assigning @jessica to customer comms. Jess, please draft an email template and internal FAQ.
jessica: drafting now. Will include what happened, what we did (container made private, keys rotated), recommended customer actions (rotate any tokens they issued), and contact for follow-up.
raj: postmortem items I propose: 1) tighten storage CORS defaults to disallow '*' 2) require PR approval + infra test for role grants 3) prevent pipelines from issuing long-lived SAS without approval 4) add detector for public-listing via CORS.
liam: add: integrate KeyVault `createSas` alerts into security dashboard and auto-revoke unscoped SAS tokens older than 24h.
sofia: adding an immediate playbook update for containment steps and communication templates.
amanda: good. I'll schedule a 1hr post-incident review in 90m. tagging: @team-eng, @security, @customer-success.
security-bot: RESOLVED: public listing removed and pipeline paused. Incident escalated to legal.
amanda: thanks everyone. Keep updates in thread. We'll produce an internal postmortem and action tracker after the RCA. :white_check_mark:
